human_review_focus: X001-X024 manifest (X017 absent in preserved baseline); X013 exact executable signal trace
Concurrent body/form Y201-Y220 uses Blob/Body/Request ownership, not pipe shutdown; facet/root and atomic accounting author lanes have separate mechanisms.

per_case_distinctness.S201: S015 drains with default close; S024 transfers writer ownership on a remote writable. This joins pipe EOF suppression with independently proven sink usability.
per_case_distinctness.S202: S006/S007 observe read errors and X006/X007/X020 propagate source failure into native transforms. This prevents forward abort and proves the surviving sink accepts new data.
per_case_distinctness.S203: S016 requires default source cancellation. This suppresses cancellation and demonstrates new post-pipe data remains readable, without relying on implementation read-ahead.
per_case_distinctness.S204: X013 fans an active signal into native transform/source shutdown. This preserves both ordinary resources after abort and proves both remain usable; not a flag permutation credited without a new lifecycle.
per_case_distinctness.S205: X013 has signal fanout but no independently held write, sink-abort acknowledgment and source-cancel acknowledgment. S020 covers queued writer close, not pipe shutdown fanout.
per_case_distinctness.S206: S015 covers transfer; S019/S020/S023 cover direct writers. No prior design holds ordinary pipeTo close acknowledgment and asserts the pipe promise and both lock lifetimes.
per_case_distinctness.S207: H017 concerns pre-dispatch HTTP abort; X013 is an already-running native pipe. This exercises the ordinary pipe pre-abort reason branch with a valid falsy reason, not malformed input.
per_case_distinctness.S208: S207 covers zero identity, while this covers early-branch asynchronous join and ownership duration. S205 reaches shutdown after a held write; pre-abort is a different implementation branch.
per_case_distinctness.S209: Neither S016 nor X013 tests shutdown action failure precedence. preventAbort deliberately isolates one failing action, so no simultaneous-rejection ordering is assumed.

not_added: No repeated default pipe success or default sink-error cancellation case.
No general flag/value matrix; zero tests reason identity in the distinct pre-abort branch.
